Job Title: AJO Platform Architect
Job Type: Fulltime
Location: USA - Remote

 

Job Description

Bounteous is looking for a Platform Architect to lead high-priority platform implementation projects and ongoing platform support across marketing automation, journey orchestration, CDP, loyalty and offer management platforms. This position sits within our martech platform team, but will regularly interface with a large, cross-functional team of developers, solution architects, marketing strategists and digital marketing specialists to help bring digital customer experiences to life. As such, the ideal candidate will be dynamic and flexible with a strong affinity toward data and process.

This position necessitates knowledge of varying industry trends, marketing automation enablement, campaign best practices, data management best practices and associated digital marketing technologies, so the ideal candidate should possess a desire to continually learn, improve and apply subject matter expertise to individual client needs. 

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary platform expert for Adobe Journey Optimizer, advising on architecture, governance, and best practices

  • Lead discovery efforts to gather necessary information from clients and internal team members to appropriately understand business needs and solution requirements for digital marketing efforts

  • Develop deep knowledge of each client's business and available data to ensure platform solutioning is on par with client's marketing objectives

  • Translate business needs into detailed technical requirements for platform configuration, data schemas, system integrations and customer journeys to deliver against business needs

  • Partner with AEP/CDP Architects and Engineers to implement XDM schemas, plan data ingestion and dataset enablement, transformations, event pipelines, and monitoring, as needed to support journey activation

  • Lead platform configuration and development of digital marketing campaigns across channels (email, SMS, push, in-app, etc)

  • Manage user roles and permissions in AJO to ensure proper access controls

  • Oversee development, testing and deployment of platform work completed by developers

  • Provide support to development teams working on platform integrations

  • Create and present Architecture and Technical specifications documents 

  • Serve as day-to-day technical platform SME to internal and client teams

  • Oversee system health and lead engineers through regular maintenance protocols to ensure compliance with organizational policies

  • Work closely with project management team to manage workflow and deadlines across multiple, simultaneous platform-related projects and change controls

  • Provide support to senior team members throughout project estimation and Marketing Technology roadmapping engagements, as needed

  • Provide support to internal execution services team for ongoing platform and schema optimizations, as needed

  • Direct technical implementation of features, as needed, is a minor percentage of overall responsibility

  • Contribute to Bounteous AEP Centers of Excellence, frameworks, accelerators, and reusable delivery assets

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience of 3+ full end-to-end Adobe Journey Optimizer implementations completed, including architecture, data design, integration, and activation.

  • 3 or more years of Hands On experience working with Adobe Journey Optimizer

  • Familiarity with setup/application of common AJO tasks: Channel Configuration, Data Sources, Events, Actions, Audience Definition, Decision Management, etc.

  • Familiarity with non-native activation, i.e., journey orchestration in AJO with customer interaction via external system

  • Adobe Journey Optimizer certification preferred

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform, RTCDP and CJA strongly preferred

  • Experienced data modeler

  • Proficiency with JSON and XML

  • Experience or familiarity with HTML, MJML, CSS and responsive email coding a plus

  • Agency experience preferred, with 2+ years experience in a client-facing role and knowledge of overall agency structures and agile project management methodologies

  • Solid understanding of digital marketing execution processes, audience segmentation methods, industry best practices, communication legal compliance, and downstream campaign analysis

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Comfortable working with all levels of an organization and capable of communicating as effectively with technical staff as with business and management

  • Familiarity with a variety of marketing automation platforms and marketing cloud solutions a plus (Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Marketo or similar)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related business or technology field, or equivalent work experience required.

_

Bounteous is focused on promoting an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the different viewpoints and experiences our diverse group of team members bring to Bounteous. Bounteous does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

• Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Job Title: Associate Director - Workfront
Location: USA
Mode of Work: Remote
Type of Job: Fulltime

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and configure Adobe Workfront solutions tailored to client needs, implementing best practices in project management and process automation to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Configure and customize Workfront, including dashboards, reports, templates, and workflows to optimize client operations.
  • Complete detailed Workfront architecture and configuration documentation for inclusion in client design documents, largely in collaboration with a business process expert/lead.
  • Implement automation rules processes within Fusion to streamline key functions, including project management and resource allocation.
  • Participate in discovery sessions and stakeholder interviews to identify business requirements and process improvement opportunities.
  • Identify enhancements and new functionalities that can benefit client instances.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve configuration-related issues, ensuring system performance and reliability.
  • Regularly update knowledge on Workfront best practices and updates to recommend and implement enhancements.
  • Provide comprehensive quality assurance for all configurations and implementations.
  • Work with clients and internal teams to develop and deliver training on Workfront solutions to promote effective usage.
  • Act as a liaison between technical and business teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
  • Provide ongoing technical support within the scope of the product to ensure client success.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in Adobe Workfront development and implementation.
  • Strong understanding of Workfront design and system integrations using Workfront Fusion, connectors, and APIs.
  • Workfront Core Developer certification or equivalent.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement automation for workflow optimization.
  • Exceptional troubleshooting skills with experience in resolving configuration issues.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a talent for driving user adoption through effective training and support.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks efficiently.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Role: Director – Analytics Platform
Job Type: Fulltime - USA
 
Job Description
Experience: 12+ Years
Role Level: Director
Primary Area: Analytics Platforms / Data & Digital Analytics

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Director – Analytics Platform to lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and evolution of enterprise analytics platforms. The role requires a strong combination of analytics technology expertise, platform strategy, technical leadership, and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the analytics platform strategy, roadmap, architecture, and capabilities aligned with business objectives.
  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable enterprise data and analytics platforms.
  • Drive integration of data across digital, customer, marketing, and enterprise systems to enable actionable insights.
  • Establish standards for data architecture, governance, security, quality, performance, and scalability.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, and business teams to define analytics requirements and solutions.
  • Lead implementation and optimization of digital analytics, customer analytics, reporting, and visualization capabilities.
  • Evaluate and recommend analytics technologies, platforms, and architectural approaches.
  • Drive adoption of cloud-based analytics and modern data architecture practices.
  • Manage platform performance, reliability, technical risks, dependencies, and continuous improvements.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architects, engineers, analysts, and platform teams.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership and client stakeholders to communicate platform strategy, recommendations, and business outcomes.

Required Skills

  • 12+ years of experience in Data, Analytics, Digital Analytics, or Analytics Platform Engineering, with experience in a leadership role.
  • Strong expertise in enterprise analytics platform architecture and strategy.
  • Experience with modern cloud data and analytics platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of data integration, data modeling, APIs, ETL/ELT, and modern data architectures.
  • Experience with digital/customer analytics platforms and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, privacy, quality, and performance optimization.
  • Strong understanding of analytics visualization and BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Experience leading large-scale analytics or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with cross-functional and globally distributed teams.
